claims.text: Baseline methods include NaiveNN, FANN, and a non-domain-adaptive baseline with bag-of-words representations and SVM classifier.
NaiveNN is a non-domain-adaptive CNN trained on the source domain, while FANN is another baseline method mentioned.
Other baseline methods include mSDA, AuxNN, and ADAN, which utilize different techniques for sentiment classification.
